GETKEYSANDFLAGS.summary: Returns the key arguments of a full command together with their access flags.
GETKEYSANDFLAGS.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of arguments of the given command.

reply_schema.description: One pair per key argument. Empty when the command has no mandatory keys and none were found.

items.description: The key and the flags of its key specification.

oneOf.description: The key specification flags, for example RO or access.

arguments.name: arg
arguments.summary: The arguments of the command, as they would be sent to the server.
